title: Alert system
description: A self-diagnosis alert of the backend, published on plant/{unit_id}/alerts/system when telemetry or the decision API falls silent, and again when the condition clears.

state.description: Whether this message raises the alert or clears it.

since_wall_ts.description: Wall-clock instant the condition started; unchanged between the raised and the cleared message of one alert.

details.description: Why the watchdog fired. Every field is optional so that a minor version can add one.
